一段程序，怎样变成 RAM 中的 12 个数和板上的输出？: How does a program produce 12 numbers in RAM and outputs on the board?
我们用 Verilog 在 FPGA 开发板里搭出一颗 CPU。它读入 MIPS: We build a CPU in Verilog on an FPGA development board. It runs a MIPS program, repeatedly adds two numbers, and finally sends 89 to the display circuit.
汇编把 RAM 基址、外设基址与循环次数装入寄存器。: The assembly program loads the RAM base address, peripheral base address, and loop count into registers.
sw 保存当前项；两次加法推进递推。分支后的地址递增是延迟槽。: sw stores the current term; two additions advance the sequence. The address increment after the branch occupies its delay slot.
把结果交给外设: Send the result to the peripherals
最后一项是 89。开关值移到显示高半字，并与结果异或形成 LED 值。: The final term is 89. The switch value is shifted into the upper halfword of the display value and XORed with the result to produce the LED value.
SoC 实例化单周期核；顶层同步开关输入并转换数码管输出接口。: The SoC instantiates the single-cycle core. The top-level module synchronizes the switch inputs and adapts the seven-segment display output interface.
12 次存储、40 字节 UART、GPIO 与 restart: 12 stores, 40-byte UART response, GPIO, and restart
当前下板镜像是单周期 SoC。逐指令画面来自 RTL 仿真回放；串口是已保存的实: The image currently loaded onto the board is the single-cycle SoC. Instruction-by-instruction views replay RTL simulation; the serial data comes from saved physical-board captures. GPIO confirms the values driven to the outputs, not the appearance of the digits as photographed by a camera.
八个开关怎样依次写满八位十六进制显示？: How do eight switches fill an eight-digit hexadecimal display, one byte at a time?
一次稳定按下保存一个字节；四个扫描相位轮流点亮两组数码管。: Each stable button press stores one byte. Four scan phases take turns lighting the two groups of seven-segment displays.
先让按键稳定: Wait for a stable button input
两级同步之后累计稳定时间，短脉冲不触发写入。: After two-stage synchronization, the circuit measures how long the input stays stable. Short pulses do not trigger a write.
一次写一个字节: Write one byte at a time
从低字节开始写入，四次后回绕；长按只写一次。: Writes start at the least significant byte and wrap around after four writes. Holding the button produces only one write.
数字变成七根线: Turn a digit into seven signals
abcdefg 高有效段码将十六进制 0–F 变成各段亮灭。: Active-high abcdefg segment codes turn hexadecimal digits 0–F into on/off states for the seven segments.
四个相位拼成完整显示: Four phases form the full display
位选和两个段码同时由同一个相位生成。: The digit-select signal and both segment codes are generated together from the same scan phase.
原框架本地修复副本: Locally repaired copy of the original framework
独立运行同样 672 次断言: An independent run of the same 672 assertions
交互是按自写 RTL 放慢的原理演示。课程接口段码高有效，与新板级 SoC 接口: The interaction is a slowed-down conceptual demonstration based on the custom RTL. The course interface uses active-high segment codes and differs from the new board-level SoC interface. These simulations do not demonstrate that the original Lab 1 project ran on physical hardware.
同一颗 CPU，为什么换 ROM 就能做两件事？: How can the same CPU perform two different tasks just by changing its ROM?
程序决定运算步骤，适配器把 CPU 的取指与读写接回课程原顶层。: The program determines the sequence of operations. An adapter connects the CPU's instruction-fetch and memory-access interfaces to the original course top-level module.
复位 PC 为 0xbfc00000；原 ROM/RAM 端口接入自写单周期核。: The reset PC is 0xbfc00000. The original ROM/RAM ports connect to the custom single-cycle core.
原单比特写使能只能表达整字存储；不把窄写放大成整字。: The original one-bit write-enable signal can represent only full-word stores. Narrow stores are not widened into full-word writes.
测试通过原按键输入操作，独立计算预期和 LED 低八位。: The test drives the original button inputs and independently computes the expected sum and the low eight bits shown on the LEDs.
20 项和 12 项的区别: The difference between 20 terms and 12 terms
课程程序保存 20 项，最后 17711；板级独立程序保存 12 项，最后 89: The course program stores 20 terms, ending at 17711. The separate board program stores 12 terms, ending at 89.
20 次 RAM 写入，首次显示，218 周期: 20 RAM writes; first display reached in 218 cycles
20 次显示；加法 36 个边界输入组合: 20 display updates; 36 boundary-input pairs for addition
原 Fibonacci 镜像只运行到首次显示；全部显示来自等待常数加速版本。36: The original Fibonacci image was run only as far as its first display update. The full display sequence comes from a version accelerated by reducing the wait constant. The 36 input pairs are not exhaustive. This is an integrated simulation with the original course top-level module, not a physical-board test of the original Lab 3 bitstream.
前一条指令还没结束，后一条能否开始？: Can the next instruction start before the previous one finishes?
五个阶段重叠工作，数据相关和内存等待会让部分阶段暂停。: Five stages overlap in execution. Data dependencies and memory waits can stall some stages.
ID、EX、MEM、WB 各自保留有效位、PC 和指令。: ID, EX, MEM, and WB each retain a valid bit, a PC, and an instruction.
新结果前推给下一条: Forward new results to the next instruction
操作数按最新的流水阶段写回结果修正。: Operands are updated using the newest available register-write results from the pipeline stages.
相关时暂停前端: Stall the front end on dependencies
load-use 与 CP0 串行约束参与暂停判断。: Load-use dependencies and CP0 serialization constraints contribute to the stall decision.
用独立模型判定退休: Check retirement with an independent model
Python 参考模型构造预期执行行为，而不是复制波形输出。: The Python reference model constructs the expected execution behavior rather than copying waveform output.
三种等待模式，真实阶段快照: Actual stage snapshots under three wait patterns
等待、13 次精确异常处理、外部/定时中断、活动复位: Waits, 13 precise exception-handling sequences, external/timer interrupts, and reset during execution
这是流水线 RTL 仿真记录，不是当前下板镜像，也不是浏览器 CPU 引擎生成的: These traces come from pipeline RTL simulation, not from the image currently loaded onto the board or waveforms generated by the browser CPU engine. In the CSV, PCs and instructions in invalid stages are merely stale register contents.
Lab 5 · 让 CPU 接受对照: Lab 5 · Check the CPU against a reference
看到程序结束，是否就足够证明 CPU 算对了？: Does reaching the end of a program prove that the CPU computed correctly?
把每次寄存器写回与 golden trace 对照，第一处差异能定位执行偏离。: Compare every register writeback against the golden trace. The first mismatch pinpoints where execution diverges.
先核实实际启用项: Verify which tests are actually enabled
运行器从 start.S 提取实际调用，并要求 TEST_NUM 为 19。: The runner extracts the actual calls from start.S and requires TEST_NUM to be 19.
检查参考记录完整性: Check the reference trace for completeness
golden trace 必须有 28,970 行且每行字段格式正确。: The golden trace must contain 28,970 lines, with correctly formatted fields on every line.
故意制造差异检验判定: Introduce deliberate mismatches to test the checker
运行器支持 wrong、truncated、extra 和 missing go: The runner supports negative tests for wrong, truncated, extra, and missing golden traces.
保留每次运行的来源: Record the provenance of each run
结果保存实际启用调用、来源摘要和仿真边界。: The results record the calls actually enabled, source digests, and the scope of the simulation.
28,970 行对照；420 次存储；19 个启用点: 28,970 lines compared; 420 stores; 19 enabled test points
原 ROM 重建与 unchanged golden 对照: Original ROM rebuilt and compared against the unchanged golden trace
文档写有 89 个功能点，提供的配置实际启用 19 个；不声称全部 89 点通过: The documentation lists 89 functional test points, but the supplied configuration enables 19. We do not claim that all 89 pass. Mismatches injected in the browser are teaching examples, not historical regression failures. The instructor's original ROM and golden files are not distributed with the public site.
遇到异常时，CPU 怎样记住从哪里返回？: When an exception occurs, how does the CPU remember where to return?
程序出错时，CPU 先记下原因和位置，再去执行处理程序。CP0 就是保存这些信息: When a program encounters an error, the CPU records the cause and location before running a handler. CP0 is the set of special registers that holds this information.
读取原因和返回位置: Read the cause and return address
Status、Cause、EPC 等寄存器提供异常处理程序需要的状态。: Registers such as Status, Cause, and EPC provide the state needed by the exception handler.
设置 EXL，并在进入第一层异常时保存 EPC 和 BD。: Set EXL, and save EPC and BD when entering the first exception level.
返回时清除 EXL；软件写入优先级低于异常和 eret。: Clear EXL on return. Software writes have lower priority than exceptions and eret.
CP0 接收 WB 保存的异常信息和返回控制。: CP0 receives the exception information and return control held in WB.
13 次精确异常处理，以及外部和定时器中断: 13 precise exception-handling sequences, plus external and timer interrupts
浏览器 EPC/BD 示例是原理演示；13 次处理流程来自独立 RTL 回归。该: The browser EPC/BD examples are conceptual demonstrations. The 13 handling sequences come from an independent RTL regression. This extension has no evidence of running in the image currently loaded onto the board and does not establish full compatibility with the MIPS32 privileged architecture.
CPU 反复读同一片内存，能否少等待几次？: Can the CPU spend less time waiting when it repeatedly reads the same memory region?
两路缓存保留最近使用的数据行；脏行被替换前必须写回内存。: The two-way cache retains recently used data lines. Dirty lines must be written back to memory before replacement.
每组保留两路数据: Keep two ways of data in each set
两套 tag、valid、dirty 状态与数据阵列记录缓存内容。: Two sets of tag, valid, and dirty state, together with data arrays, track the cache contents.
地址分解后比较请求行与两路标签，有效且相等才命中。: After splitting the address into fields, compare the requested line's tag with both ways. A hit requires a valid entry and a matching tag.
替换策略同时确定旧行是否已修改、原内存行地址是什么。: Replacement logic also determines whether the old line has been modified and identifies its original memory-line address.
后端请求根据 WRITEBACK / REFILL 状态选择方向和地址。: Backend requests select their direction and address according to the WRITEBACK or REFILL state.
浏览器交互是两路 Cache 原理模型。6 组联合回归来自真实 RTL；Cach: The browser interaction is a conceptual model of a two-way cache. The 6 integrated regression configurations use actual RTL. Neither the cache nor the pipeline is part of the image currently loaded onto the board.
串口里的真实板子: The physical board through its serial port
电脑怎样知道板子算出了什么，并改变 LED？: How does the computer read the board's result and change its LEDs?
电脑问一次，板子回答一份状态。这里保留了实际的关灯、开灯、恢复自动控制和重新运行: Each query from the computer receives a status response from the board. These saved captures show actual commands that turned the LEDs off and on, restored automatic control, and restarted execution.
UART 有接收器、发送器与 320 位快照缓冲区。: The UART has a receiver, a transmitter, and a 320-bit snapshot buffer.
? 命令保存 telemetry 和 MCPU 标识，随后每次发送一个字节。: The ? command captures the telemetry and MCPU identifier, then transmits one byte at a time.
关灯、开灯、恢复、重启: LEDs off, LEDs on, restore, restart
0、1、a 控制 LED 覆盖；r 只触发 CPU 复位脉冲。: 0, 1, and a control the LED override; r triggers only a CPU reset pulse.
SoC 把错误、退休、GPIO、显示、存储、周期、结果、PC、状态组装为遥测。: The SoC assembles error, retirement, GPIO, display, store, cycle, result, PC, and status fields into telemetry.
真实串口带时间戳记录: Timestamped captures from the physical serial port
点击只选择或播放已保存的记录，不会发送板卡命令。40 字节协议帧可由记录字段重新: Clicking only selects or replays saved captures; it does not send commands to the board. The recorded fields can be re-encoded into 40-byte protocol frames, but the JSONL stores decoded fields, not raw serial-byte captures. Buzzer command records do not establish that sound was recorded.
